TLINE.TDLINE: &TITLE&
Sync SE und Pathlock Bridge.
&PURPOSE&
Sie können Regelwerksdaten zwischen Separations Enforcer und Pathlock
Cloud übertragen.
&INTEGRATION&
&PREREQUISITES&
&FEATURES&
&SELECTION&
&STANDARD_VARIANTS&
&OUTPUT&
&Limitations&
Dieses Programm funktioniert bei Regeln einfacher Funktionen, d.h. bei
komplexen Regeln in einem Objekt können mehrere UND/ODER-Einträge
manuell aktualisiert werden.
&EXAMPLE&
Angenommen, in einer Fkt. FF09 hat das Objekt F_LFA1_APP vier Einträge:
zwei mit 'oder' und zwei mit 'und'. Dann ist nach der Aktualisier. mit
diesem Programm manuelle Arbeit aufseiten der Pathlock Bridge nötig.
&TITLE&
SE Cloud Integration
&PURPOSE&
This report facilitates the synchronization of the SE ruleset with the
Pathlock cloud, and vice versa. Synchronizing the ruleset allows for the
transfer of rule content between the SE and the cloud environment. At
present, the synchronization process supports the transfer of ruleset
information (excluding organization-specific values) and mitigation
details.
&PREREQUISITES&
<ZK>Maintain Configuration</>
Enter hostname and port number of PLC instance. Create one API user with
Pathlock Bridge role assigned to the PLC system and enter its
credentials in username and password field.
<ZK>Maintain Sensitivity</>
Map risk sensitivities exist in PLC with sensitivities that exist in SE.
&FEATURES&
Selecting SOD version:
SE SOD Version: Add the SOD version you wish to synchronize.
Create new version: It will enable you to create a new SOD version.
New Version text: Add Descripiton for the new SOD version.
Action
This section is used to synchronize ruleset information between the SE
and Pathlock cloud. It is divided into two parts: one for pulling data
from the cloud and the other for pushing data from SE to the cloud.
First Part: Pulling Configuration
ABAP Application:
System ID: Specify the system whose ruleset configuration you want to
pull from the cloud.
Functions: Select this option if you want to pull functions from the
cloud. Note: The system ID is mandatory to pull functions.
Conflicts: Select this option if you want to pull conflict data from the
cloud.
Validate Incompatible Objects: Check this option if you want to identify
cloud objects that are incompatible with the SE system.
Second Part: Pushing Configuration
ABAP Application:
System Independent: Choose this option if you want to push
system-independent data to the cloud.
Schemas: Select this option if you want to push application areas.
Groups: Select this option if you want to push function groups.
Rules: Select this option if you want to push rule conflicts.
Rules Override: If enabled, this will replace the existing rules in the
cloud with the new ones being uploaded, without retaining the oldrules.
Activity Mode Values: This will upload activity mode values to the cloud
System Dependent: Choose this option to upload system-dependent data to
the cloud.
System: Select the system for which you want to upload ruleset data.
Activity Mode: Uploads function details at the object level to the cloud
Activity Mode Override: If enabled, it will replace the existing
activity mode with the new one being uploaded, without retaining the old
one.
Group Components: Uploads function details at the transaction code level
to the cloud.
Group Components Override: If enabled, this will replace the existing
group components with the new ones being uploaded, without retaining the
old ones.
Mitigation Details Integration:
Mitigation Definition: Synchronizes mitigation definitions between the
SE and cloud systems.
Mitigation Assignments: Synchronizes mitigation assignments between the
SE and cloud systems.
&SELECTION&
&STANDARD_VARIANTS&
&OUTPUT&
&Limitations&
